mailwoman:sources.citation: The Storting resolved on 14 June 2022 to divide the counties of Viken, Vestfold og Telemark and Troms og Finnmark, with effect from 1 January 2024. ISO 3166-2:NO lists the resulting 15 counties.

The union of the Who's On First localadmin records Larvik (1159296779), Færder (1159297071), Sandefjord (1159297193), Tønsberg (1527971073), Holmestrand (1527971075), Horten (1527971077). Each member is assigned to the county that GeoNames files most of the populated places inside its boundary under, counted on 2026-11-26. Every municipality has at least 80% of those places in one county.
